title: Give Me Back My Miaoyi
summary: Ye Fan forces his way into An Miaoyi's sea of consciousness and relives their past there: she asked him, through an intermediary, to be her Dao Protector before her breakthrough to the Four Poles, and swore she would kill him if she failed. Later came the news that Ye Fan had only fourteen days to live and that Feng Huang had broken off their engagement, and An Miaoyi, refusing to kill him, wanted him to live. His persistence draws out the An Miaoyi he knew. She explains that while he was gone she reached the gate of Dao Severing (the 3rd Heaven) and chose to cut away the part of herself tied to him; if she succeeds, everything will come back to her. She refuses his help as her Dao Protector until his Holy Body is perfected, and says her Dao lies in the Western Desert, where she will go again. Ye Fan swears to smash all cause and effect, and even Mount Sumeru, to win glory in this life. Knowing she hasn't much time left, she offers to dance one last dance for him.
